title: Compliance Officer
description:
Why Join dLocal ? dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60+ countries across emerging markets-moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300+ teammates from 40+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.
What's the Opportunity?

We are looking for a Compliance Officer based in Senegal to join our global team. This role is open to the whole of Senegal and plays a crucial part in our banking relationships, local regulatory compliance, and internal reporting. You will serve as the primary compliance contact for all matters within the WAEMU/BCEAO zone.
What will I be doing?

KYC Onboarding

• Oversee and manage the Know Your Customer (KYC) onboarding process for new customers and update existing ones across Senegal.

• Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory requirements related to customer identification and verification, including BCEAO and CENTIF directives.

Transaction Monitoring

• Implement and enhance transaction monitoring systems to detect and report suspicious activities within the Senegalese context.

• Conduct periodic reviews and assessments to ensure the effectiveness of transaction monitoring processes.

AML/CFT Compliance

• Serve as the primary point of contact for AML/CFT matters in Senegal.

• Possess in-depth knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorism Financing (CFT) regulations in Senegal, including WAEMU directives, BCEAO instructions, and FATF recommendations.

• Develop and enforce AML/CFT policies and procedures tailored to the Senegalese regulatory environment.

Regulatory Compliance

• Stay abreast of the regulatory landscape governing the payments and financial services industry in Senegal and the wider WAEMU/ECOWAS zone.

• Interpret and communicate regulatory changes, especially those related to AML/CFT requirements, to relevant stakeholders within the organisation.

• Establish and maintain strong relationships with Senegalese regulators, including the BCEAO, Ministry of Finance, CENTIF, and ARTP (for mobile money services).

Remittance Compliance

• Develop and implement compliance procedures specific to domestic and cross-border remittances in Senegal, including key corridors such as West Africa-Europe and intra-ECOWAS transfers.

• Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements governing remittance services in the Senegalese market, with particular attention to diaspora and family remittance flows.

Risk Assessments

• Conduct regular risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential compliance risks within the Senegalese and WAEMU context.

• Collaborate with other departments to implement risk mitigation strategies.

Reporting

• Report findings and compliance matters related to AML/CFT to different stakeholders in a clear and understandable manner.

• Ensure timely and accurate reporting to internal and external stakeholders as required by Senegalese regulations, including suspicious activity reports to CENTIF and BCEAO regulatory filings.

Training and Awareness

• Provide training to staff on compliance policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, with a specific focus on AML/CFT in the Senegalese market.

• Foster a culture of compliance awareness within the organisation.

What skills do I need?

Education & Certifications

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field; a degree from a Senegalese or WAEMU-region institution is an advantage.

• Professional certifications are a must: CAMS, ACAMS, ICA, or an equivalent qualification recognised in Francophone Africa.

Experience

• 4-6 years of experience in a compliance role within the banking, fintech, or financial services sector, ideally with exposure to the WAEMU/ECOWAS region.

title: AI Engineering Manager
description:
AI Engineering Manager

We're setting up a new AI team within Data and AI and are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead it. Good engineering management makes a big difference to how well teams grow, keep their people and deliver, and that is what we want from this role.

You'll look after the planning and people side: delivery, growth, performance, culture and hiring. You work alongside technical leads who own architecture, technical direction and hands-on execution. You need each other, so expect to work closely.
We'll judge you on how your engineers develop and what your team delivers. Most of your time goes to understanding how the business works and unlocking use cases where AI makes a real difference, next to leading your people and your delivery.

What you'll do:

• Get to know how the business runs. Spend time with the teams, understand their processes and find where AI, or sometimes just a better tool, would help.

• Unlock use cases and take them from first idea to something live, including the business case and how success will be measured.

• Own the AI roadmap: set priorities and sequence the work in line with company goals.

• Coach and develop your engineers, including career planning, promotions and regular performance conversations.

• Build the team: hiring, headcount planning and allocating people to the work that matters most.

• Keep the team healthy. Pay attention to morale and productivity, and deal with conflict early.

• Hold regular one-on-ones, give feedback on time and make room for team building.

• Turn technical and business requirements into clear delivery plans, and flag dependencies and risks up front.

• Work with Engineering, Trading and Quant to design and roll out new AI solutions.

• Track progress against plan, handle risk and scope trade-offs, and keep stakeholders informed.

• Keep improving how we deliver and how fast the team moves.

• Stay aligned with company goals and timelines, working closely with Tech Leads and Staff Engineers on technical direction.

What we're looking for:

• A good eye for processes. You've worked out how things really run, changed them yourself and can tell when a problem needs AI and when it doesn't.

• Strong project management: roadmaps, sequencing, dependencies and risk, in a fast-moving environment.

• Enough technical background to earn your engineers' respect and join technical discussions with credibility.

• Experience leading software engineers, growing them and managing their performance.

• A track record of delivering software through a team while balancing scope, quality and timelines.

• Good people skills: coaching, giving feedback, resolving conflict and creating a team where engineers do their best work.

• Good judgment when hiring and developing people.

• Real interest in AI. You follow what's happening and can tell what matters for us.

• Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, including cross-functional stakeholders like Trading and Quant.

• Based in Amsterdam, or willing to relocate.

title: Head of Sales Excellence & Methodology
locationText: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's sales organization is growing quickly across segments, industries, and geographies, and how we sell has to mature as fast as the team does. We are looking for a Head of Sales Excellence & Methodology to own the substance of sales enablement at Anthropic: the sales methodology itself, the standard for what excellent selling looks like here, and the change management that makes it stick in the field.

You will define a common way of selling that holds up across very different customers, from startups to the largest global enterprises, and then lead the organization through adopting it. That means earning sponsorship from senior sales leadership, equipping frontline managers to coach to the methodology instead of only inspecting for it, and building alongside sellers so the result reflects how deals are really won.

This is a leadership role for someone who has taken a sales organization through real transformation and can show that it changed behavior and results. You will set direction, [build and lead a team], and stay close enough to the field to know when something is not working.

Key responsibilities:

•
Define, document, and evolve Anthropic's sales methodology and process standards, including discovery, qualification, deal strategy, and deal review, so that sellers in every segment and region share a common language

•
Design and run the rollout and reinforcement of methodology changes across the sales organization, securing executive sponsorship and making clear what is expected of each level of sales leadership

•
Equip frontline managers to coach to the methodology in pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and forecasting, so that it becomes part of the operating rhythm

•
Sequence and deliver complex, multi-audience programs across geographies, segments, industries, and roles that scale globally while adapting where local or segment differences matter

•
Develop content, frameworks, and standards together with sellers and sales leaders, testing them on live deals before scaling

•
Define the leading and lagging indicators that show whether the methodology is changing seller behavior and outcomes, and act on what the data shows

•
Partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and the wider Sales Enablement team so the methodology is reflected in systems, messaging, and day-to-day workflows

•
Apply Claude and internal tooling to personalize coaching and reinforcement, so that quality does not depend on headcount

Minimum qualifications:

•
Practitioner-level expertise in sales methodology and sales process design, including discovery, qualification, deal strategy, deal review, and forecasting

•
Have led a methodology or sales process change across a sales organization, and can show how seller behavior and results changed as a result

•
Have run enablement or sales excellence programs spanning multiple geographies, segments, industries, or roles

•
Have worked directly with senior sales leaders and frontline managers to secure sponsorship for change, including holding a position constructively when they disagreed

•
Have built programs with sellers and sales leaders, testing them on live deals, instead of handing down finished programs

•
Have defined and tracked adoption and impact measures that go beyond completion and satisfaction scores

•
Communicate clearly, in writing and in conversation, with executive audiences

Preferred qualifications:

•
Experience building and leading a team of senior enablement or sales excellence professionals

•
A clear, experience-based view of where common sales methodologies break down in practice

title: Senior Payroll Specialist
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT YOU

LiveKit's team is growing fast, in the US and around the world, and Finance is taking over payroll. You'll be the person who makes it run: every employee, every state, every country, every filing.
Most senior payroll roles hand you a well-oiled machine and ask you not to break it. This one asks you to build it. You'll own US and international payroll, set up the calendar and controls, assist with month end close, and be the internal expert on anything that touches a paycheck.

You'll thrive as the Senior Payroll Specialist if you:

- are obsessive about tying out numbers to the penny

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Payroll Specialist at LiveKit, you will:

- Run US and international payroll end to end, from collecting inputs to final reconciliation

- Own all associated payroll tax filings, domestic and international, and keep us compliant and on time

- Manage our PEO and EOR relationships, and know where their responsibility ends and yours begins

- Reconcile payroll to the general ledger each cycle and support month-end close

- Build and maintain our payroll calendar, processes, and documentation as payroll moves into Finance

- Partner with People/Talent and accounting on new hires, changes, terminations, and month-end reconciliation

- Support equity administration in Carta and equity reporting for the board

- Be the go-to contact for payroll questions internally and for auditor requests externally

WHO YOU ARE

- Hands-on experience running both US and international payroll, including Canada and/or the EU

- Experience managing payroll tax filings directly, not just handing them off to a provider

- Experience with multi-state US payroll for a remote, distributed team

- Strong experience working within PEO and/or EOR structures

- Familiarity with startup-focused platforms such as Rippling, Deel, Remote, or similar

- Comfort working independently as the subject-matter expert, juggling many moving pieces and flagging tax, legal, and compliance risk before it becomes a problem

NICE TO HAVE

- CPP, FPC, or a similar payroll certification

- Experience moving payroll in-house, switching providers, or migrating an HRIS

- Experience with equity administration in Carta

- Experience at a fast-growing company with a distributed, international team

- You've personally caught a payroll error before anyone else did, and you still think about it fondly

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research

As the Head of Site for our first ever sortation centre in the US, you’ll own performance, safety, people, and flow every shift. This is a hands-on operational leadership role where calmness under pressure, disciplined execution, and evidence-based problem solving define success.

You will directly manage our operations managers and work closely with central teams focused on Workforce Management and Training & Education to ensure the site runs safely, efficiently, and on time.

This role is perfect for operators from aviation, rail, manufacturing, or other high‑reliability environments who excel in fast-paced, 24/7 operations.

- Lead Daily Operations: Own the sortation floor with a visible, on-the-ground leadership presence.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 WHERE YOU'LL FIT IN:

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Engineer II roles (usually 4-8 years exp) are available remotely within Japan or hybrid from Tokyo.

 

OUR TECHNOLOGY

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.

 

WHAT WE DO

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

At Kraken, you won't be boxed into one rigid path. Depending on your strengths and interests, you might find yourself modeling local energy markets, scaling a financial product across international territories, or driving the core comms engine behind all Kraken communications. Alternatively, you could be working directly with clients to enhance Kraken to solve their business needs or localise a particular market and help onboard their customers into the system. Whichever team you join, you’ll be solving complex problems with a group of genuinely great people.

We hire Engineers who have the skills and drive to keep growing. In this role, you will:

- Core Delivery: Solve complex domain modeling challenges in the energy sector, writing robust, fault-tolerant software primarily in Python, Django, GraphQL, Celery, and PostgreSQL.

- Code Quality & Testing: Write clean code alongside unit, integration, and functional tests covering happy path, boundary, and exceptional scenarios.

- Problem Solving & Debugging: Use structured methods to debug production issues, learn from failures, and build familiarity with a large, complex codebase.

- Documentation: Write clear, useful documentation for new and existing features to support your team and non-technical stakeholders.

- Collaboration: Share opinions respectfully, accept actionable feedback gracefully, and actively contribute to a supportive, growth-focused team culture.

For Eng II candidates, you will additionally:

- Feature Ownership & Observability: Confidently own and deliver medium-sized engineering problems, address system observability gaps, and manage technical escalations independently.

Project Details:

NETGEAR is growing its enterprise networking business, and we're looking for a Product Manager to own a key part of it. We're looking for someone who knows the technology, listens closely to customers, and measures success by what ships and what sells.

- Own the roadmap for your product area. Turn customer needs, market trends, and competitive intelligence into a prioritized plan that drives revenue and adoption.

- Write clear, testable requirements (PRDs, epics, user stories) that engineering can build from without guesswork.

- Partner closely with engineering, QA, and UX through the full lifecycle: definition, development, beta, launch, and sustaining.

title: Freelance or permanent - Senior .NET Developer - Blazor UI (Blazor, UI focus)
description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities
In a public-sector digital-services environment, you will develop secure, accessible and responsive business applications that support citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users in Belgium. You will work across the application stack, from the Blazor user interface to the .NET services behind it, while contributing to technical decisions and supporting colleagues.
You will join an ICT department of approximately 250 professionals working on more than 50 projects in different development phases. The organisation is modernising its application landscape towards a cloud-native architecture on Microsoft Azure, using Azure Service Bus and containerised workloads. A platform engineering team provides shared libraries, the design system, DevOps pipelines and standards for the application teams.
Web user interfaces are standardised on Blazor, allowing one .NET skill set to cover the complete application. The UI is the part of the application used by citizens, healthcare professionals and employees, so it must be accessible, consistent and responsive. The organisation is also exploring the responsible use of AI in business applications and software development.
Job purpose
As Senior .NET Developer with a UI focus, you will design, develop, integrate and maintain modern business applications. You will take ownership of their user interfaces while contributing to the underlying services. The role combines advanced hands-on development with technical leadership, coaching and close collaboration with analysts, architects, UX stakeholders, security specialists, the platform engineering team and operations.
You will translate functional and technical requirements into reusable, accessible solutions. Your work will support a consistent user experience across devices and browsers, correct integration with services and APIs, reuse of the shared component library and design system, and compliance with standards for architecture, security, quality, maintainability and delivery.
As a senior developer, you will help resolve complex technical issues, make well-founded design choices, improve engineering practices and support colleagues through coaching and code reviews. The role remains strongly hands-on, with direct contributions to feature development, testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement across both the UI and its supporting services.
Key responsibilities

• Provide technical direction for Blazor development across teams and promote consistent UI architecture, reusable components, coding standards and engineering practices in line with the platform team's standards.

• Develop features, reusable components, prototypes, technical improvements and bug fixes using C#, modern .NET, Blazor, Razor components and the .NET Web APIs on which they depend.

• Design scalable, maintainable and reusable front-end structures that align with the organisation's architectural principles, and contribute to the shared component library built on MudBlazor and the shared design system.

• Build responsive interfaces with semantic HTML and modern CSS that meet WCAG 2.1 level AA, as required of Belgian public bodies under the European Web Accessibility Directive. Consider usability, browser compatibility and the public-service context throughout the development process.

• Work with functional and business analysts and UX stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess feasibility and translate user and business needs into sound technical solutions.

• Integrate Blazor applications with REST APIs and JSON-based services, including typed clients, suitable error handling, state management, validation and resilience. Extend the Web APIs when a feature requires it.

• Implement secure authentication and authorisation flows using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect for internal users, healthcare professionals and citizens, each with its own identity provider. Apply secure development practices throughout the application lifecycle

description:

This is a fully remote position , open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.
Job Title: VP of Robotics Research
Job Type: Full-time
Location: Remote

The Role
As VP of Robotics Research with us, you will define and lead our research agenda for Physical AI - intelligent systems that can understand, reason about, and act in the physical world.
Our research focuses on four connected areas:

• Physical Agents & Robotics - building agents that perceive, reason, plan, and act through robots, machines, instruments, and other physical systems.

• Learning & Data - studying how demonstrations, trajectories, sensor data, simulation, feedback, and autonomous experience improve physical-world intelligence.

• Evaluation & Generalization - developing rigorous methods to measure physical reasoning, manipulation, planning, robustness, safety, and transfer across tasks and environments.

• Physical-World R&D Automation - exploring how agents can accelerate scientific and engineering workflows through simulation, experimentation, design, fabrication, and real-world tools.

You will set research direction across these areas, stay close to models and physical systems, build a world-class research team, and partner with leading AI and robotics labs on their hardest Physical AI problems.
What You’ll Do

• Set the Physical AI research agenda. Identify the highest-leverage problems across robotics, embodied agents, learning, data, evaluation, and physical-world automation.

• Build agents that act in the physical world. Develop systems that connect foundation models and agents to robots, machines, instruments, and other physical interfaces.

• Advance general-purpose robot learning. Lead research across vision-language-action models, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, world models, and multimodal policies.

• Develop a science of physical-world data. Study which demonstrations, trajectories, sensor streams, environments, and supervision signals best improve learning and generalization.

• Build scalable data-generation systems. Develop methods for generating high-quality interaction data through human demonstration, teleoperation, autonomous rollout, simulation, and hybrid human-agent workflows.

• Advance evaluation and generalization. Build rigorous benchmarks for manipulation, spatial reasoning, planning, tool use, robustness, safety, and transfer across tasks and embodiments.

• Bridge simulation and reality. Study how simulated and real-world experience should be combined and where sim-to-real transfer breaks down.

• Advance physical-world R&D automation. Build agents that operate across scientific and engineering workflows, including simulation, experimentation, design, fabrication, and laboratory systems.

• Build research that compounds. Create reusable datasets, environments, simulators, hardware testbeds, evaluation infrastructure, and research tools.

• Build and lead the research team. Recruit and develop exceptional researchers and engineers, partner with leading labs, and publish consequential research.

What We’re Looking For

• Deep Physical AI expertise. Significant experience in robotics, embodied AI, robot learning, autonomous systems, or related fields.

• Strong learning and agentic systems intuition. Deep understanding of modern robot learning, multimodal models, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, world models, planning, and control.

• Physical systems intuition. Strong understanding of sensing, calibration, control, contact, actuation, latency, uncertainty, and hardware constraints.

• Exceptional research taste. You identify problems that can meaningfully expand what AI systems can do in the physical world.

description:
YAMU Media is looking for a Talent Recruiter located outside of the United States to join our team. The role is open to people located in Latin America, Asia or Africa.
Job title: Recruiter
Job Overview
YAMU Media is a performance marketing agency working with B2B SaaS, ecommerce, and local businesses across the US market. We are a remote-first team of people who move fast, hold high standards, and care about building something worth working at.
We are looking for a mid-level recruiter to own hiring execution across YAMU. This is not a coordinator role. You will be the person who sources, screens, and moves candidates through the process with structure and speed, reporting directly to the Head of People. You will typically work across three to four open roles at once, all within marketing and paid media. You are the one who protects the pipeline by making sure only candidates who actually meet the bar get to the hiring manager, and that every candidate who touches YAMU leaves with a good impression of us, regardless of outcome.
Key Responsibilities
You will own sourcing across platforms including LinkedIn, Upwork, and our ATS, running both inbound screening and outbound outreach depending on the role. You will conduct screening calls that go beyond logistics: your job is to gather the information the hiring manager actually needs, flag misalignments early, and make a clear recommendation. You will coordinate technical tests and schedule interviews, making sure every step of the process is clean and no candidate falls through the cracks.
A big part of this role is calibration. You will work closely with the hiring manager to understand what each role actually requires, and you will make sure every candidate you advance has been evaluated against the full job description and the technical expectations set by the hiring manager. You will not pass someone through because they seemed nice. You will not advance someone because they interviewed well but can't do the work.
You will also take candidate experience seriously. That means timely updates, clear communication about next steps, and closing every candidate loop, including the ones who don't move forward. You will track pipeline activity and report on the status of open roles so that leadership always has visibility without having to ask.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple requisitions, and prioritize effectively.

• Familiarity with SaaS, digital marketing, or tech-enabled service environments is highly beneficial.

• Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and experience implementing fair, non-discriminatory hiring practices.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
